choices.why: This dark brown aged-leather three-seater fits the request exactly, and at 218 cm it anchors the open space without crowding it.
It has a solid wood slatted top on black metal sled legs, and at 135 cm it is well proportioned to the sofa.
Its warm wood shelves on slim black metal posts give the industrial wood-and-metal look and echo the beams and stair.
This black swing-arm lamp with brass details is a classic industrial piece and suits reading from the sofa.
It is large enough to sit under both sofa and table, and its rust and terracotta motifs bring the earthy warmth that pairs with the leather.
A pair of rust cushions picks up the rug's terracotta and contrasts warmly with the dark leather.
It is the only dark, plain pot that fits the dark-metal palette and can hold a larger plant by the window.

answer.why: Aged leather, solid wood and black metal repeat the warm tones of the beams and floor, and the rust accents on the rug and cushions bring earthy color without any bright white.
